assertions.name: healthy: dashboard shows real API and database status matching the API
degraded: stopping PostgreSQL shows Degraded within 15 s, readiness 503, liveness 200
recovery: restarting PostgreSQL returns to Healthy within 30 s without restarting api/web
unreachable: stopping the API shows API unreachable and no stale database data
boundary: identity, organization and catalog features are not implemented
observability: one trace threads browser → web → API → PostgreSQL, with metrics and no secrets
stored logs: outage warnings are stored in Loki, correlated to their trace, metrics stored, no secrets
observability resilience: the app stays healthy when the telemetry collector is down
secret scan of compose logs and status evidence
